# Stage arcs

Doctrine 0.1.0. Selected by the install's stage_arc option. Every dryback band here describes the OVERNIGHT (daily) dryback, from the day's peak to the trough before lights-on. Dryback points are points of TRUE water content from the GrowLabs pages; vendor relative figures are the share of peak. Code converts them to a relative figure from the zone's own peak and sends the zone's observed overnight dryback beside it; neither is a value for dryback_target, which compares other drops (DRY-02). Pore EC is root-zone EC in mS/cm; runoff is % of water fed.

### Stage arc `slab_default`: Slab guide / vendor arc: generative setting, vegetative bulk, generative finish (GL-SLAB, VND-IRRIGATION)

Default because: The vendor handbook and the slab guide agree on it.

| stage | flower_days | steering | peak | dryback_points | dryback_relative_vendor | pore_ec | runoff_pct | move_on_when | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| established veg |  | vegetative | at or above field capacity | 10-15 | 30-40 | 3-5 | 8-16 | roots established and uptake repeats day to day |  |
| flower setting (stretch) | 1-21 | generative | at or below field capacity | 15-25 | 40-50 | 5-10 | 1-7 | vertical stretch has clearly slowed or stopped | start near the low end and deepen over three weeks; never cross the established minimum moisture |
| flower bulk | 22-42 | vegetative | at or above field capacity | 10-15 | 30-40 | 3.5-6 | 8-16 | flower expansion slows and ripening signs dominate |  |
| finish | last 10-14 days | ripening | at or below field capacity | 20-25 | 40-50 | 3-4 | 1-7 | maturity by trichomes, a person's call | deeper only on cultivar data; runoff higher only to correct excess EC |
